parsed.rationale: All three members — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same package (`Wallpaper`) with `shared_field_count: 16` and `differing_slots: null`, meaning their union case sets are structurally identical. The three aliases exist solely to give domain-specific names to what is effectively the same type, which creates maintenance burden: any change to the 16 shared cases must be replicated across all three files. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to define a single canonical `BlendMode` type-alias-union in the `Wallpaper` package and replace the three aliases with `typealias PlaybackBlendMode = BlendMode`, `typealias MaterialBlendMode = BlendMode`, and `typealias OverlayBlendMode = BlendMode` (or remove the aliases entirely if call-site names are not part of the public API). None of the records carry test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so there is no intentional-duplication exemption.
